title: rosa × dumetorum decalvata
intro: Rosa × dumetorum decalvata, commonly known as the deciduous Rosa × dumetorum, is a hybrid plant species of the Rosa genus. It is a type of shrub that has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The Rosa × dumetorum decalvata is valued for its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, reduce fever, and prevent infections. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
